arc_fence.note: Jarlink / Lightning Fence: the arc between two Jarlinks' jars, stretched along x (y = 8 on the line). Loop.

aura_ring_breath.note: White, tint it and scale it to the aura's range (64 px = 1 cell radius 28). Brighter (higher alpha) in build mode.

beacon_flare.note: Beacon: a flare shooting up from the Beacon (anchor = its top) and bursting; the ring of light that follows is drawn in code (BeaconRing).

brood_end.note: Brood Cap / Hatchery: static marker where a sprite's walk gives up (a dotted ring round a little cap). Draw at texture size, centred on the anchor, z -1.

brood_hatch.note: Brood Cap / Hatchery: where a spore-sprite drops onto the path (anchor = the drop spot), at the attack's release frame. Spores fall in, a pink puff blooms, a ring marks the spot. ~0.43 s.

carried_storm.note: Samara seed trail. White: tint with the carried Reaction's callout colour; stretch along the seed's path like light_thread.

catcher_fill_dewcatcher.note: Frame = fill level (0 empty .. 3 full), not animation. Same origin as the Warden sprite; add bowls.dewcatcher.dy_by_frame[idle frame] to y.

catcher_fill_wellspring.note: Frame = fill level (0 empty .. 3 full). Same origin as the Warden sprite; add bowls.wellspring.dy_by_frame[idle frame] to y.

caught.note: Dreamcatcher: loops over a Caught (sleeping, +damage) nightmare. Draw above it.

chain_badge.note: Pop-in; hold the last frame. Draw chain_digits centred on it (x then the number).

chain_digits.note: Bitmap font: frame i is glyph i of `glyphs` ('x' = the multiply sign). 7 px advance.

chain_link.note: Icon beside the chain badge's "Chain N" text. Loops a glint; use chain_link_bright from Chain 5.

chorus_note.note: Lullaby Bell: one per chorus voice, riding the pulse ring. Tint.

clean_cut.note: Whetstone / Edgestone: the finishing slash on the nightmare it finishes (centred on it), ~0.33 s.

clean_spill.note: Edgestone: the overkill jumping from the finished nightmare to the next one. Stretch along x (y = 6 on the line), killed -> next.

cloud_puffs.note: Variants, not frames: PathCloud picks one per puff and tints it with projectile_color.

crowned_avalanche.note: Anchor = where the stone lands; the ice spreads over the lob's area (about 3 cells wide).

crowned_callout_frame.note: Nine-patch behind a Crowned callout: patch margins 6 px left/right, 5 px top/bottom.

crowned_card_accent.note: Gold corner for a Crowned discovery card: top-left corner, mirror it for the other three.

crowned_codex_silhouette.note: Undiscovered Crowned Reaction in the Codex. Family icon slots (18 px, centres): (22, 80), (48, 84), (74, 80); put the family icons (assets/meta/icons/family_icons.png) in them.

crowned_crown.note: Crown mark for a Crowned callout: sits centred on top of the callout text (anchor = its base).

crowned_starfall.note: Anchor = the impact point; the column falls from the top.

dark_swirl.note: Starling Murmuration: a one-cell swirl of starlings, 2 s loop (16 frames at 8 fps).

dawnburst.note: x10 chain. Screen-level: draw centred on the reaction, above the map.

dew_catch_droplet.note: Drawn flying right; rotate to its travel. Arc it into the catcher; harvest_pour reuses it.

dew_pop_gold.note: Behind the "+N Dew" of caught Dew; draw that text in gold (#ffd870) instead of blue.

double_graft_glow_a.note: Grafted Elder: the left half of the graft glow; tint with the first copied Warden's colour. Play with _b: they swap brightness.

double_graft_glow_b.note: The right half; tint with the second copied Warden's colour.

drag_dust.note: Soil kicked up behind a dragged nightmare; spawn one every ~0.1 s along the drag. Anchor = ground.

dream_spore_puff.note: Dreamshroom: slow spore puffs rising off a sleeper; loop while it sleeps (anchor = its feet).

dreamlight_shard.note: Great Dreamcatcher: dropped by a Caught nightmare when dispelled. Loops until collected.

echo.note: Echo Hollow: play with the repeated Reaction (which can also be drawn at ~60% alpha, lilac-tinted).

fairy_circle_ring.note: One ring tile (the 8 around the held nightmare, path tiles only), loops for 6 s. Draw under nightmares.

fairy_dance.note: Elf Circle: a ring of lights spinning round a nightmare's feet (anchor = the ground under it), loop.

firework_burst.note: Sparkler / Starburst: a firework bursting over a crowd into 6 sparks (Starburst: play two, offset).

flyer_grab.note: Groundroot / Earthbind: roots shooting up from the ground and dragging the flyer down (anchor = the flyer), ~0.5 s.

fog_wisps.note: Variants: fog strands PathCloud drifts across fog clouds (cloud_fog).

gale_lane.note: Zephyr: a gust streak along the path; tile/stretch along x, y = 6 on the line. Tint (or leave pale).

goal_hold.note: Deeproot: a root coil snapping round the held nightmare's feet (anchor = its feet), ~0.5 s.

grafted_harmony_a.note: Graftling's two-colour glow, left half. White: tint it with the first status colour (modulate). Pair with grafted_harmony_b.

grafted_harmony_b.note: Right half; tint with the second status colour.

ground_slam.note: Quaker / Earthshaker: the slam ring centred on the Warden, drawn for a 1.5 cell radius (96 px); scale x1.33 for Earthshaker's 2.

harmony_beam.note: Old Kin Harmony strike: a beam from each Warden to the nightmare (stretch or tile along x, y = 4 on the line, 0.3-0.4 s). White: tint with the Warden's colour lerped ~30% to warm gold (#ffe890).

harmony_bloom.note: Where the two harmony_beams meet on the nightmare. Tint with a mix of the two colours (or warm white).

harmony_petals_a.note: Blooming Harmony strike: petals spiral in from the left and open half a flower. Tint with the first Warden's colour; play with harmony_petals_b.

harmony_petals_b.note: The other half, from the right; tint with the second Warden's colour.

harmony_spark_a.note: Tiny: a petal spirals in from the left and sparks. Tint with the first Warden's colour; play with harmony_spark_b.

harmony_spark_b.note: The other petal, from the right; tint with the second Warden's colour.

harvest_pour.note: At the bowl (anchor = bowl surface): droplets leap up and out. Then fly dew_catch_droplet beads to the Dew counter (~0.8 s).

harvest_splash.note: UI: where the harvested Dew lands on the Dew counter.

ink_trail.note: Inkcap / Deliquescent: the ink a Poisoned nightmare leaves on the path. Tile along x behind it (y = 6 on the line), under the nightmares; fade over its life. Deliquescent's 2-tile pool: two segments side by side, or scale it.

kin_bond_burst.note: Plays on both Wardens when a bond forms (~0.6 s). Tint with the family colour.

kin_callout_frame.note: Nine-patch behind a Kinship callout: patch margins 7 px left/right, 5 px top/bottom.

kin_codex_frame.note: Locked "???" Kinship entry: a vine border round a dark panel (nine-patch margins 14 px).

kin_leaf_icon.note: Kinship mark for callouts and the Codex.

kin_oldkin_arch.note: Old Kin: a flowering arch over the pair. Anchor (0, 31) = left foot, right foot at (63, 31): stretch along x between the two Wardens' bases (don't scale y). Gentle: ~50-70% alpha. Tint with the family colour.

kin_stage_up.note: A Kinship grows a stage: leaves unfurl and a small flower opens. Anchor = its base.

kin_vine_bead.note: Runs along the vine from one Warden to the other when a borrowed trait fires (~0.3 s). Drawn moving right: rotate to the vine. Tint with the family colour.

kin_vine_blooming.note: Ground vine between two kin Wardens: stretch or tile along x (tiles every 32 px), y = 5 on the line. Tint with the family colour; drawn under the Wardens, ~30% alpha most of the time.

kin_vine_grow.note: The bond moment: a blooming vine grows left to right with a bright bud at its tip. Stretch it between the two Wardens (or clip kin_vine_blooming instead).

kin_vine_oldkin.note: Ground vine between two kin Wardens: stretch or tile along x (tiles every 32 px), y = 5 on the line. Tint with the family colour; drawn under the Wardens, ~30% alpha most of the time.

kin_vine_sapling.note: Ground vine between two kin Wardens: stretch or tile along x (tiles every 32 px), y = 5 on the line. Tint with the family colour; drawn under the Wardens, ~30% alpha most of the time.

landing_dust.note: Cairn / Rockslide: where the lobbed stone lands. Anchor = impact point.

landslide_boulder.note: Boulderback: a rolling boulder, turning a notch per frame; move it along the path, play landslide_dust behind it.

landslide_dust.note: The boulder's dust trail: tile/stretch along x behind it (y = 8 on the ground line), fade the far end.

leaf_mote.note: Near-white, tint it. Very subtle: drift it slowly upward over aura-boosted Wardens, low alpha.

light_thread.note: Stretch or tile along x from a Warden to the reaction; starts and ends at y = 4.

lightning_rod.note: Anchor is the impact point; the bolt falls from the top.

lob_shadow.note: Under a lobbed stone, on the ground below it; scale it down as the stone rises.

logjam_knot.note: Snugroot: under a held nightmare (anchor = ground under its feet), loops while it's held.

long_way_home_drag.note: Roots dragging a nightmare back: stretch along x from where it was to where it lands (x = 0 end).

mended_leaf.note: Great Dreamcatcher: a mended leaf the code flies to the Heartwood; loops its tumble.

monsoon_sweep.note: Tiles in x and y. Fill Monsoon's range and slide it across while it rains.

moonstone_beam.note: Moonstone's first shot on each nightmare: a moonbeam from above. Anchor = where it lands.

nightbloom_cloud.note: One path tile, loops while the cloud lasts. Draw under nightmares.

overgrowth_cloud.note: One path tile (64x64), loops while the cloud lasts. Draw under nightmares.

path_crack.note: Earthshaker: the crack left on a path tile. Forms up over 3 frames; hold the last frame (static) for the 3 s, z -1.

path_furrow.note: Ground decal: tile or stretch along x from where the drag started to where it ended, y = 8 on the line, under the nightmares. Translucent, fade out over ~1 s.

peck_spark.note: Hummingbird: one per peck (6-8 a second), so it's tiny and quick.

prism_beam.note: Rainbow Prism: a split beam, white so it tints (pink #ec9cf4, gold #fcd47c, blue #9cd4fc for the three). Stretch along x, y = 3.

rain_sweep.note: Nimbus's Cloudburst, played on the Warden (anchor = its base): its cloud bursts and a ring of rain sweeps out from it (it reads as range ~1.5 cells; scale up for range 4).

rain_zone.note: Cloudlet / Nimbus: rain over a 3x3 zone. Tile it 3x3 (it tiles seamlessly), above the nightmares at ~80% alpha.

rockfall.note: Bastion: a rock falling from a stone wall onto the path tile beside it. Anchor = the tile centre; impact on frame 3.

root_grab.note: Frames 0-2 burst, 3-5 wrap and hold (loop 4-5 while the nightmare is held / dragged), 6-7 sink back. Anchor = ground under the nightmare's feet; draw it under the nightmare with a front copy (or just above it at ~80% alpha).

rubble.note: Rockslide: one path tile of slowing rubble. Draw under nightmares. Loops: Fx.play(&"rubble", tile, world, 1.0, true, 3.0) holds it 3 s and fades it out.

shard_rise.note: Dream Oak / Dreamroot: a Dreamlight shard rising out of it at the end of a drift (anchor = its top).

shatter_chain_burst.note: Hoarfrost: an ice burst with shards flying out (smaller than crowned_prismstorm).

silence_mark.note: Hushbell / Silence: over a silenced nightmare's head (anchor = the top of its head), loop while silenced. A muffled bell, its sound crossed out.

solstice_fork.note: Midsummer: a bright flash where the beam forks (anchor = the fork point; rays drawn pointing right, rotate to the beam).

sound_cone.note: Thrum / Resonance: arcs of sound rolling out in a cone, drawn pointing right from the anchor (rotate to aim; scale y to widen the cone for Resonance).

spark_burst.note: Sparkler / Starburst's firework at the burst point (and Fireworks Fence's crossing burst): a smaller, quicker burst than firework_burst.

spore_arc.note: Brood Cap / Hatchery: spores streaming from the attack origin to the drop spot. Stretch along x (y = 6 on the line), Warden -> spot, ~0.35 s.

spore_sprite_burst.note: Brood Cap / Hatchery: a spore-sprite bursting on the nightmare it bumped (anchor = the sprite). Sized for the 1.5x sprite; scale x1.5 for Hatchery's big one.

sprout_puff.note: Seedbearer / Grove Keeper: the free Sprout popping up on its cell (anchor = the cell centre).

starlit_snare.note: Starcave: a star glint popping on a path tile (anchor = tile centre, on the ground).

status_flash.note: One row per status (top to bottom in `rows`); each sheet row is 32 px tall.

still_pool.note: One path tile, loops for the pool's 5 s. Draw under nightmares.

stone_up.note: Rampart / Bastion: a Thornwall touching it hardening to stone. Same frame layout as a Warden (64x80, body in the bottom 64, anchor = the cell centre); play over the wall, then swap its texture to thornwall_stone.png.

storm_front.note: Wraps a Reaction set off by a status Gust carried: play over the Reaction's effect.

surge.note: x5 chain: stretch over the whole screen and fade alpha 0 -> 0.8 -> 0 over ~0.5 s. Two hard bands of warm light (AI-look audit: no soft gradients).

thorn_spread.note: Crown of Thorns: a thorny vine growing from the held nightmare to its neighbour. Stretch along x (y = 6 on the line).

thorns.note: Thorncoil: thorns pricking a held nightmare, round its feet (anchor = its feet). Loop while it's held.

thunderclap_arc.note: Stretch or tile along x between two points; starts and ends at y = 8.

thunderhead_strike.note: Thunderhead's every 5th strike. Anchor = ground impact; the bolt comes from the sky above.

toll_ring.note: Silver Bell / Vesper Bell: the toll landing on its far target: a silver ring spreading on the ground under it (anchor = its feet).

veil_glint.note: Morning Fog: a faint gold glint where the fog cancels hiding or healing. Play at ~70% alpha.

water_jet.note: Jetreed / Torrent: the jet, stretched or tiled along x from the reed to the end of its line (y = 5). ~0.3 s. Torrent's wet trail: ink_trail-style decal not needed, reuse dew_pool art or tint ink_trail blue.

whirlpool.note: Undercurrent / Maelstrom: a whirlpool on one path tile, under the nightmares. Loop.

whole_tree_badge.note: Small leaf badge on the family's Wardens after a Whole Tree.

whole_tree_sigil.note: Plays ON the Heartwood: same 128x128 frame as its sprite, anchor (64, 88) = the Heartwood's position, so Fx.play at heartwood.global_position lines it up. Draw above the Heartwood (~1.2 s, settles at the end). Tint with the family colour.

windmill_momentum.note: Windmill spin-up: 3 intensity levels x 4 looping frames (frames 0-3 = level 1, 4-7 = level 2, 8-11 = level 3). Anchor = the sail hub (Windmill idle art: (9, 19) in its 64x64 frame).
